title: RetroRapid!
subtitle: Three lanes. Rising speed. One more run.
description:
RetroRapid! brings back the charm of classic LCD handhelds from the late '80s and early '90s. Steer left or right, dodge traffic, and chase a high score as the road gets faster. Every overtake counts; one crash ends the run.

Built natively for Apple Watch, iPhone, iPad, and Mac, RetroRapid! fits wherever you play. Use taps, swipes, a keyboard, the Digital Crown, or a supported controller, while Game Center leaderboards, achievements, and friend markers give you another score to chase.
nameOrigin: Unexpectedly released with love ❤️ from the ARCtic conference in Oulu, Finland. Thanks to everyone that played the game and encouraged me to push the button.

features.title: The look you grew up with
features.description: RetroRapid! channels classic LCD handhelds with a clean, native implementation. Unlock Unlimited Plays to choose from the available visual themes and make the retro look your own.
features.imageDescription: RetroRapid! on iPad using the green Pocket visual theme, with pixel cars on a three-lane road and large red controls at each side.

features.title: Native Cross-Platform Play
features.description: Play on Apple Watch, iPhone, iPad, or Mac with an interface and controls tailored to each device, not a phone screen stretched across platforms.
features.imageDescription: A person playing RetroRapid! on Apple Watch beside the water, with the watch and racing screen centered in the photo.

features.title: Game Center Competition
features.description: Game Center tracks leaderboards by platform and speed, unlocks achievements for streaks, totals, and control styles, and places friends' best scores on the road as markers to chase.
features.imageDescription: RetroRapid! on Mac showing an achievement sheet over the racing screen for completing a run with VoiceOver controls.

features.title: VoiceOver, Cues, and Haptics
features.description: RetroRapid! supports VoiceOver and Direct Touch, pairing spoken feedback with configurable audio cues and haptics. Pause to hear the road layout, and choose how speed changes are announced.
features.imageDescription: A close-up of RetroRapid! settings on iPhone showing speed-increase warning feedback, a preview warning, Detailed Road, Big Cars, and Direct Touch.

features.title: Play your way
features.description: Race with taps, swipes, keyboard arrows, the Digital Crown, or a supported MFi, Xbox, or PlayStation controller. Remap controller actions and tune sound, haptics, fonts, and road options.
features.imageDescription: RetroRapid! on Mac with the Settings window open over the racing screen, showing font, speed, audio feedback, volume, control help, and accessibility options.

features.title: Adaptive Interface by Default
features.description: RetroRapid! supports Larger Text, Dark Interface, sufficient contrast, Reduce Motion, and portrait or landscape play. Big Cars makes targets easier to see and tap.
features.imageDescription: A hand holding an iPhone in portrait orientation running RetroRapid!, showing the retro-styled Score display and pixelated car sprites in a real-world setting

whySection: RetroRapid! is built around nostalgia, accessibility, and native Apple-platform craft. Runs are quick, the challenge is fair, and feedback works visually, audibly, and through haptics. Play free each day or unlock Unlimited Plays with one purchase: no subscription and no data collection.
supportText: Need help with RetroRapid! or want to share feedback? We're here to help you enjoy the retro racing experience!
